summary: StudentDemographics is a web user control for managing student demographic data, including birth date, ethnicity, and citizenship information. The control allows data viewing, editing, and validation, and supports pop-up modals for detail editing. It interacts with backend data sources and maintains user session state.
purpose: To display and edit demographic information for a student within the HSPnet system, supporting workflows for updating, viewing, and validating demographic details including birth date, ethnicity, and citizenship.

workflows.name: View Demographics
steps: System binds demographic fields (birthDate, ethnicity, citizenship)
Codes for Ethnicity and Citizenship are loaded and bound to dropdowns

workflows.name: Edit Demographics
steps: System switches FormView to edit mode
System displays editable fields and pop-up modal if required
System validates and binds updated values

workflows.name: Update Demographics
steps: System redirects user to the Demographics page

business_rules: Ethnicity and citizenship codes must be valid and exist in respective code tables
User session must be valid for selection/update operations
If user does not have permission or screen is not editable, edit controls are disabled
validations: birthDate parsed and validated from input
Dropdowns for ethnicity and citizenship default to valid selections
conditions: If ScreenIsEditable is true, show edit controls
If UserSession is null, cancel selection
system_behavior: Pop-up modal for editing details using ModalPopupExtender
Redirect to Demographics page after update
exceptions: Invalid user session cancels data selection
Incorrect code values result in failed binding
Page controls not found disables edit capability
content_gaps: Field-level validation logic details are incomplete
No descriptive UI layouts or complete field lists
Business rules for code values (Ethnicity, Citizenship) are referenced but not specified
